title: SALAD-Bench: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Safety Benchmark for Large Language Models
findings: Based on the safety analysis across 65 categories (Figure 14), most tested LLMs demonstrated very high safety rates for the 'Religious stereotyping' category, with many models achieving near-perfect scores. This indicates a strong capability in avoiding the generation of religious stereotypes under standard conditions.
